# Update Panorama folder documentation to the surviving interface

Accepted documentation still links the removed nsIFolder/Folder files and describes read-only Folder objects returned by getFolderById/getFolderByPath. The current nsIFolderDatabase getFolderByPath returns a numeric ID, uses 0 for missing, and getMsgFolderForFolder returns the existing nsIMsgFolder interface. Recommend revising that section to the surviving API, rather than teaching the historical object shape as current. Exact removed paths were checked locally; runtime migration was not run. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mailnews/db/panorama.
